hints: Identify all forces acting on the particle: weight $12g$ vertically downwards, normal contact force $R$ perpendicular to the plane, horizontal push $P$, and friction $F$ acting down the plane.
Because the particle is on the point of moving up the plane, the friction is limiting: $F = \mu R = 0.8R$.
Resolve forces perpendicular to the plane to obtain $R$ in terms of $P$: $R = 12g\cos 25^\circ + P\sin 25^\circ$.
Resolve forces parallel to the plane: $P\cos 25^\circ = 12g\sin 25^\circ + F$, substitute $F = 0.8R$ and the expression for $R$, and solve for $P$.
walkthrough:
State the limiting friction formula for impending motion:
$$F = \mu R$$
With $\mu = 0.8$, the maximum friction force is $F = 0.8R$. Because motion is impending up the slope, friction acts downwards along the line of greatest slope.

Resolve forces perpendicular to the inclined plane, taking the upward normal direction as positive:
$$R - 12g\cos 25^\circ - P\sin 25^\circ = 0$$
Substitute $g = 10\text{ m s}^{-2}$ and isolate $R$:
$$R = 12 \times 10 \times \cos 25^\circ + P\sin 25^\circ$$
$$R = 120\cos 25^\circ + P\sin 25^\circ$$

Resolve forces parallel to the inclined plane, taking the uphill direction as positive:
$$P\cos 25^\circ - 12g\sin 25^\circ - F = 0$$
Substitute $12g = 120\text{ N}$ and $F = 0.8R$:
$$P\cos 25^\circ = 120\sin 25^\circ + 0.8R$$

Substitute the expression for $R$ into the parallel equilibrium equation:
$$P\cos 25^\circ = 120\sin 25^\circ + 0.8(120\cos 25^\circ + P\sin 25^\circ)$$
Expand the brackets on the right-hand side:
$$P\cos 25^\circ = 120\sin 25^\circ + 96\cos 25^\circ + 0.8P\sin 25^\circ$$
Subtract $0.8P\sin 25^\circ$ from both sides to group $P$ on the left-hand side:
$$P(\cos 25^\circ - 0.8\sin 25^\circ) = 120\sin 25^\circ + 96\cos 25^\circ$$

Evaluate the trigonometric quantities using $\cos 25^\circ \approx 0.906308$ and $\sin 25^\circ \approx 0.422618$:
$$\text{Coefficient of } P: \quad 0.906308 - 0.8 \times 0.422618 = 0.906308 - 0.338094 = 0.568214$$
$$\text{Constant term}: \quad 120 \times 0.422618 + 96 \times 0.906308 = 50.7142 + 87.0056 = 137.7198$$
Divide to calculate $P$:
$$P = \frac{137.7198}{0.568214} \approx 242.37 \approx 242\text{ N}$$
